stale-sandboxes.change: Review stale sandboxes with the platform owner and remove unused allocations after rollback checks.
stale-sandboxes.method: Unused cohort weekly vCPU-hours divided by pooled billed daily vCPU-hours, capped at 100%. Use telemetry on unmetered days and claim CHF only on allocated billing.

subscription_consolidation.name: Consolidate duplicate subscriptions
subscription_consolidation.change: Cancel tools whose function the existing Microsoft 365, Copilot or project scheduling licences already provide at their next notice date, export their data, and move the remaining monthly AI plan to annual billing.
subscription_consolidation.method: Per contract: 12 x August CHF minus the saving already counted by the seat clean-up. Moved users who need seats on the retained tool are charged at its August per-seat rate. Annual billing = retained seats x (1 - annual / monthly list price). Notice periods are checked against the as-of date. No energy change is booked. Effort: one person-day on top of the two-day seat clean-up review, because notices go out in the same renewal workflow and Teams video is already in use. The target is met only at this estimate; 1.5 days or more misses the cost target.
subscription_consolidation.approval: Head of Finance, Head of IT and the affected tool owners
checks: Tool owners confirm feature parity, data export and that no customer or contract requires the cancelled tool.
